_doc.about: Whether new mail lands in a bundle, for the server's choice not to notify about bundled mail. Run by shared/src/bundles.spec.ts; functions imports the same code.
_doc.cases: arrivalBundleLabels(labels, bundleOff) is labels: the thread's user labels (ids starting Label_) and categories other than Primary, without those in bundleOff, in order; none when the thread is starred or hasTodo (optional: it has a todo the apps show). bundledOnArrival(labels, bundleOff) is bundled: it has any of those labels, however many inbox threads carry it (even this one alone).

cases.name: a user label bundles, though no other inbox thread has it
a category other than Primary bundles like a user label
Primary and system labels never bundle
a label with bundling off doesn't count
a starred thread is pinned and never bundled
a thread with a todo the apps show never bundles
